desc: Precompute data for each digit d = 1..9 (p0, p, factor, need table, and initialize buckets).
Initialize structures (cur_rem_arr, cur_periodic_arr, empty prefix placement).
Iterate over the string, counting substrings ending at each position r when s[r] != 0 using the precomputed factors and need tables.
Update cur_rem for all d after each position.
Update buckets for all d (rotate periodic buffer, shift preperiod, insert new prefix, move bucket from preperiod to periodic when needed).
